name: Exp_SSL
summary: Exp_SSL is an Expert Advisor based on the SSL (Senkou Line Span) indicator, which uses moving average channels to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the SSL indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA provides a systematic trend-following approach with optional trailing stop functionality.
summary_zh: Exp_SSL是一个基于SSL指标的智能交易系统，通过移动平均通道判断趋势方向。当SSL指标显示上升趋势时开多仓，显示下降趋势时开空仓，并可配置止损止盈。该EA提供系统化的趋势跟踪交易方法，并带有可选的移动止损功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用SSL指标进行趋势跟踪交易。SSL指标通过两条移动平均线的相对位置关系来判断市场趋势方向，当快线上穿慢线时产生买入信号，当快线下穿慢线时产生卖出信号。入场条件依赖SSL指标的颜色切换或线形交叉确认趋势转变。出场条件包括预设的固定止损和止盈，以及可选的移动止损来锁定利润。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，但没有明显的动态仓位调整或基于账户余额的比例仓位管理。资金管理较为基础，主要依靠止损来控制单笔风险，缺少最大回撤限制或总体风险敞口控制机制。整体策略逻辑清晰简单，但缺乏对震荡市和假突破的过滤机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses the SSL indicator for trend-following trading. The SSL indicator determines market trend direction through the relative position of two moving average lines, generating a buy signal when the fast line crosses above the slow line and a sell signal when the fast line crosses below the slow line. Entry conditions rely on SSL indicator color switching or line crossover confirmation of trend change. Exit conditions include preset fixed stop loss and take profit levels, plus an optional trailing stop to lock in profits. In terms of position sizing, the EA supports fixed lot trading but lacks dynamic position adjustment or balance-proportional sizing. Money management is relatively basic, primarily relying on stop loss to control per-trade risk, without maximum drawdown limits or overall risk exposure control mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is clear and simple, but lacks filtering mechanisms for ranging markets and false breakouts.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for distinguishing orders

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和调试
具有止损和止盈设置，基本风险控制到位
支持移动止损功能，可以动态锁定盈利
使用魔术编号管理订单，避免与其他EA冲突
趋势跟踪策略在明显趋势行情中表现良好
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
Has stop loss and take profit settings with basic risk control in place
Supports trailing stop functionality to dynamically lock in profits
Uses magic number for order management to avoid conflicts with other EAs
Trend-following strategy performs well in clear trending markets
cons: 缺乏震荡市场过滤机制，在横盘行情中容易产生频繁虚假信号
仓位管理仅支持固定手数，没有基于账户资金比例的动态仓位调整
缺少最大回撤限制和总体风险敞口控制
未进行新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能影响交易效果
cons_en: Lacks ranging market filtering, prone to frequent false signals in sideways markets
Position sizing only supports fixed lots without dynamic proportional adjustment based on account equity
Missing maximum drawdown limit and overall risk exposure control
No new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
No spread filter, trading performance may be affected in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，避免在震荡市中频繁交易
实现基于账户余额比例的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
添加新K线检测机制，防止同一根K线上重复开仓
增加最大回撤限制和每日最大亏损限制，提升资金安全性
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage instead of fixed lots
Add new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate position opening on the same bar
Add maximum drawdown limit and daily maximum loss limit to enhance capital safety

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能在同一K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
没有点差过滤，高点差时入场成本偏高
固定手数不随账户变化调整，大账户风险敞口可能过大
在震荡市中缺乏过滤，可能连续止损
risk_points_en: No new bar check, potentially causing overtrading by opening duplicate positions on the same bar
No spread filter, entry costs may be too high when spreads widen
Fixed lot size does not adjust with account changes, risk exposure may be excessive for large accounts
Lacks filtering in ranging markets, may result in consecutive stop losses
